text: Screen customers against a global database of sanctions, warnings, fitness and probity lists, watchlists, PEP registers and adverse media
quote: you can check your customers against a global database of Sanctions, Warning, Fitness and Probity and Watchlists, Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) and Adverse Media.

text: Configure the equation used to calculate customer risk scores
quote: You have the ability to configure the equation that calculates the risk score of your customers.

text: Case management for prioritising and reviewing risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring
quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.

text: Generate API credentials with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date
quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.

text: Create multiple screening configurations and choose one per customer at screening time
quote: You can create multiple configurations and select the appropriate one for each customer during the screening process.

text: Choose which screening lists each screening configuration uses
quote: Screening configurations should be set up in collaboration with a compliance or risk team to ensure the appropriate screening lists are selected.

text: Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, assignee or creation date
quote: Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.

text: Record case decisions: no risk detected, risk detected and accepted, or risk detected and offboard
quote: They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.

text: Retrieve the audit log trail for a case
quote: Returns the audit log trail for a case.

text: Review and remediate cases, alerts and risks in the web app or through the API in your own case management system
quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.

text: Webhooks include a webhook-id header that can be used as an idempotency key
quote: Every webhook we send carries a `webhook-id` header... Use it as your idempotency key.

text: WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook delivers screening results, including whether hits were found
quote: Set up a webhook of type `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`... Refer to the `customer-screening.step_output.screening_result` field in the webhook payload to determine if any hits were found

text: Optional per-account webhook signing
quote: Webhook signing is opt-in per account.

text: API response headers report current rate limit usage
quote: The API response headers will include up-to-date information on the rate limit usage

text: Postman collection and downloadable OpenAPI (Swagger) schema
quote: ComplyAdvantage offers a Postman collection to help you on your integration journey... you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema

text: Synchronous screening API for real-time onboarding and asynchronous screening for high volumes
quote: Synchronous screening: Ideal for real-time onboarding workflows where low latency is critical. Asynchronous screening: Suitable for high-volume screening scenarios

text: Batch Processing API for high-volume processing
quote: For high-volume processing, use the Batch Processing API.

text: API endpoint to get the ongoing-monitoring status of a single customer
quote: This endpoint returns the monitor status for a single customer.

text: Set the monitoring configuration for a customer, including monitoring and unmonitoring customers
quote: This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.

text: Create data exports by selecting an export type and a date range
quote: Create a new export by selecting an export type and a start and end date.

text: Export types cover customers, screenings, cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring alerts and transactions
quote: CUSTOMER_SCREENING, CUSTOMER, SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES, PROFILES, PAYMENT_SCREENING_CASES, TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS, TRANSACTIONS.

text: Export download URLs expire 5 seconds after they are issued
quote: the returned download URL is valid for only 5 seconds (TTL) from the moment it is issued

text: Export transaction data as CSV for use outside the platform
quote: It is possible to select and export transaction data as a CSV file to use outside the ComplyAdvantage platform as needed.

text: API endpoint to view roles in the account, gated by permission
quote: You need the "View roles in account" permission to use this endpoint.

text: Submit a transaction through the API to run payment screening and transaction monitoring
quote: Creates a transaction and executes our payment screening and transaction monitoring processes.

text: Look up customers by external identifier through an endpoint that returns a 308 redirect
quote: based on the provided external identifier.

text: Versioned API endpoints, with a new version released for each backwards-incompatible change
quote: A new version of an API endpoint is released whenever a new *backwards incompatible* change is released.

text: Screen and manage both individual and company customers
quote: A customer is a person or company that has a direct relationship with your company.

text: AI agent for customer screening and ongoing monitoring
quote: Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent

text: AI agent for transaction monitoring
quote: Transaction Monitoring agent

text: AI automatically escalates high-risk or complex cases for human expert review
quote: high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.

text: AI auto-remediates level 1 alerts
quote: auto-remediating level 1 alerts

text: Starter Plan AI agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized
quote:
Can I customize the agents' configuration?

The agent configurations on the Starter Plan are standardized for all customers and cannot be customized.
